summary: Interface-gated vector compositing dispatch (canonical name COMInterfaceVectorProcessingMethod): validates an interface header, rejects mismatched width/depth fields, dispatches to a format-specific handler selected by the header value, and when no handler applies falls through to a generic 2x2 float-vector averaging path over staging buffers allocated with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper and freed with FreeWrapper_7bcf.

operations.description: SEHHandlerInit() sets up the structured exception handling frame for the function.
Guard on the interface header byte at v4 + 8: when it is not 5 the function returns -2147467259 immediately.

Validation guards on width/depth fields: v10 from v9[1046] must equal v8 >> 1 (or both equal 1), v11 from v9[1047] must equal v7[1047] >> 1 (or both equal 1), and v9[1048] plus v7[1048] must both equal 1, else return -2147467259.
When v8 is greater than 1 and odd, normalize it: v7[1046] = v8 & 0xFFFFFFFE and decrement the header field at offset +4196 by the value at offset +4200.
Clear the low bit of the header field at offset +4188 when it exceeds 1.
Guard on the byte flag at v5 + 10: when bit 8 is set, control jumps to the generic fallback path (LABEL_44).
Dispatch eligibility guard: the header value v14 at *v5 + 4 must match the peer value at v5[1] + 4, and the fields at +4184 and +4188 must both be at least 2, otherwise fall back to the generic path.

Format dispatch selected by the header value v14 (the switch is grounded by the jpt_504C3F jump table): 21 -> PhysicsStateDispatch, 22 -> VehicleDataForwardingCall, 23 -> sub_503920(v5), 24 -> sub_503A70(v5), 25 -> F_16BitTextureBlending(v5), 26 -> BitplaneBlendingCompositing(v5), 27 -> PixelBlenderCompositor(v5), 28 -> F_2xBoxDownscale(v5), 29 -> ImageBlendCombine(v5), 30 -> sub_50415C(v5), 40 -> F_2xBoxDownscale(v5), 50 -> F_2xBoxDownscale(v5), 51 -> sub_50427D(v5), 52 -> sub_5043C9(v5). A non-negative result returns 0; failure falls to the generic path.

Generic path staging allocation: allocate 16 * width bytes with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, initialize the elements through sub_5008C2(v23, 16, width, sub_5007EC), and store the buffer pointer; when the allocation fails return -2147024882.

Second staging region: when the field at *v5 + 4188 equals 1 a single 16 * width buffer is allocated and initialized, otherwise a doubled 16 * (2 * width) buffer; the buffer pointers are recorded in the caller frame slots.

2x2 float-vector averaging loop over the staging buffers: for each output row and each source position, sum the four vectors from the buffer slots, scale each component by the 0.25 constant (flt_59E7F8), write the four results, invoke the interface method at vtable + 4 for the source offset, and advance rows until the row counter reaches the height field.
FreeWrapper_7bcf releases the staging buffers (the double buffer and the primary buffer) after the averaging pass.
Returns 0 on handler success, -2147467259 on validation failure, and -2147024882 when a required allocation or buffer pointer is missing.
Called by D3DContextInit (0x005063A5) to run texture vector compositing during Direct3D context setup.
